people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “Sanctify to me all the firstborn, whatever opens the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of animal. It is mine.”
translations.bsb: “Consecrate to Me every firstborn male. The firstborn from every womb among the Israelites belongs to Me, both of man and beast.”
translations.kjv: Sanctify unto me all the firstborn, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast:
translations.asv: Sanctify unto me all the first-born, whatsoever openeth the womb among the children of Israel, both of man and of beast: it is mine.
